newsitem.title: ALBANIA: EU mission in Albania as flight from unrest goes on.
newsitem.headline: EU mission in Albania as flight from unrest goes on.

text.p: A European mission to Albania held more talks with the government on Tuesday on how to restore order and ensure food supplies after weeks of anarchy as ordinary Albanians continued to flee the country.
On Monday the European Union delegation headed by a top Dutch diplomat heard from beleaguered Albanian President Sali Berisha that his country needed food, medicine and help with its police force.

Members of the delegation were due to travel to the port of Durres, 30 kms (20 miles) west of Tirana, which has witnessed chaotic scenes over the past few days as Albanians desperate to leave the country fought to get on anything afloat.
